Objective: Install and maintain network security controls
Application to MediCare Plus: Segment the payment environment from clinical and IT networks and from public Wi-Fi, since reception and the portal both touch cardholder data
Change default vendor passwords on POS terminals and harden terminals before use
Avoid retaining cardholder data (a third party processes payments); where any is stored, render the PAN unreadable (encrypted, truncated, masked or hashed); never store the CVV after authorisation
Use strong cryptography whenever cardholder data crosses an open network
Protect reception systems and the online payment channel from malware

Objective: Develop and maintain secure systems and software
Application to MediCare Plus: Defend the live patient portal against SQL injection, XSS and similar vulnerabilities; patch promptly

Objective: Restrict access by business need to know
Application to MediCare Plus: Only staff with a documented need (billing, reception) can reach cardholder data or payment systems
Unique logins and MFA for anyone using payment terminals or the portal admin panel
Secure POS terminals, receipts showing PANs and any physical media at reception

Objective: Support information security with policies and programmes
Application to MediCare Plus: Information security policy, third-party assessments, incident response plan and ongoing staff awareness training
